text: This is Foldline. It turns code into finished video, fast, right on your Mac.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: This is Foldline. It turns code into finished video, fast, right on your Mac.

text: Every frame you see here is drawn by code in a browser canvas. No video generation. No stock footage.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: Every frame you see here is drawn by code in a browser canvas. No video generation. No stock footage.

text: The usual way to save those frames is slow. Each one is screenshotted, squeezed into a JPEG, piped out, decoded again, and encoded by software.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: The usual way to save those frames is slow. Each one is screenshotted, squeezed into a JPEG, piped out, decoded again, and encoded by software.

text: We timed it. Drawing a frame takes about four milliseconds. Moving it around took most of the time.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: We timed it. Drawing a frame takes about four milliseconds. Moving it around took most of the time.

text: Foldline skips all of that. The page hands every frame straight to the Mac's hardware video encoder, and it never leaves the graphics chip.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: Foldline skips all of that. The page hands every frame straight to the Mac's hardware video encoder, and it never leaves the graphics chip.

text: An eighty-three second Short used to take sixty seconds to build. Now it takes about thirty.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: An eighty-three second Short used to take sixty seconds to build. Now it takes about thirty.

text: A full eight-minute film went from seven minutes to under three, using eighty-six percent less CPU.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: A full eight-minute film went from seven minutes to under three, using eighty-six percent less CPU.

text: And the picture stays the same. Put the frames side by side, and you can't tell them apart.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: And the picture stays the same. Put the frames side by side, and you can't tell them apart.

text: It checks its own work, too. If a page can't use the fast path, it falls back on its own. And it won't hand you a video with missing sound.
instruct: A clear, friendly tech explainer narrator, confident and warm, steady unhurried pace, a little smile in the voice
display: It checks its own work, too. If a page can't use the fast path, it falls back on its own. And it won't hand you a video with missing sound.

text: It comes with the full lemo-opuscar library by LemoLab. Sixty-six film styles, from watercolor to pixel art, each with its own demo.

display: It comes with the full lemo-opuscar library by LemoLab. Sixty-six film styles, from watercolor to pixel art, each with its own demo.

text: To start, clone the repo, install, and render. It's one command.
